mapper.sql: INNER JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions cv2 WHERE cv2.card_id = cv.card_id AND (cv2.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (cv2.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND cv2.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) )

SELECT c.card_id, c.issuer_id, cv.name AS card_name, c.card_type, cv.image_url FROM cards c
WHERE c.issuer_id = #{issuerId} ORDER BY c.card_id ASC

SELECT g.option_group_id, g.group_key, g.group_name, c.option_choice_id, c.choice_key, c.choice_name FROM card_option_groups g INNER JOIN card_option_choices c ON c.option_group_id = g.option_group_id WHERE g.card_id = #{cardId} AND g.parse_status = 'verified' AND c.parse_status = 'verified' ORDER BY g.option_group_id ASC, c.option_choice_id ASC
